name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance support for notified crops and seasons. Enrollment, covered risks, and claim requirements are season and location dependent.
benefits: Insurance cover for notified crop losses; coverage, premium, and claim conditions vary by notified crop and season.
eligibility_criteria: Notified crop, area, season, and enrollment window apply.
Check the current notification and policy terms on the official portal.
required_documents: Aadhaar or other accepted identity document
Land/tenancy and sowing details as required
application_steps: Check the current state and season notification.
Apply through an authorized channel during the enrollment window.
Retain the application and policy acknowledgement.
note: Eligibility, notified crops, and enrollment dates must be confirmed for the farmer's location and season.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Central income-support programme for eligible landholding farmer families, subject to official exclusions and verification.
benefits: Income support under the current programme rules for eligible farmer families.
eligibility_criteria: Landholding and exclusion criteria are governed by current official programme rules.
e-KYC and land-record verification may be required.
application_steps: Review current eligibility and exclusion rules.
Complete registration or status verification through the official portal.
Complete e-KYC and correct any record mismatch.
note: The prototype cannot check land records, exclusions, e-KYC, or payment status.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Soil testing and nutrient-management information to support informed farm input decisions.
benefits: Soil-test results and nutrient-management recommendations through the applicable state process.
eligibility_criteria: Availability and process depend on the state soil-testing programme.
Check with the local agriculture department for sampling and card status.
application_steps: Contact the local agriculture office or soil-testing laboratory.
Arrange plot sampling through the applicable state process.
Review results with an agriculture extension professional.
note: Local sampling access and current service availability require confirmation.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
description: Water-use and irrigation programme with components implemented through applicable central and state guidelines.
benefits: Potential support for eligible irrigation or water-efficiency components under current state implementation.
eligibility_criteria: Component, beneficiary, cost-sharing, and application rules vary by state and activity.
Check current state notifications before purchasing equipment or starting work.
required_documents: Component-specific quotations or technical documents, if required
application_steps: Identify the applicable state component.
Confirm eligibility and application timing with the implementing department.
Follow approved procurement and inspection requirements.
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / State Implementing Department
note: Specific subsidy rates and eligibility are not inferred by this prototype.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization
description: Agricultural mechanization support implemented under current programme guidelines and state application windows.
benefits: Potential access to approved machinery assistance or custom-hiring services, subject to current rules.
eligibility_criteria: Eligible equipment, beneficiary categories, assistance, and application windows are defined by current guidelines.
Confirm the state-specific process before purchase.
required_documents: Equipment quotation and category documents, if required
application_steps: Check currently approved machinery and state application window.
Apply through the authorized state portal or department.
Wait for approval before purchase where required.
note: A scheme match is not approval for subsidy or equipment purchase.

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture
description: Horticulture development programme with components delivered through state action plans and current guidelines.
benefits: Potential support for approved horticulture development components under current state plans.
eligibility_criteria: Eligible crops, components, beneficiaries, and assistance are specified by current state guidelines.
Check the local horticulture department before investment.
required_documents: Component-specific project or cost documents, if required
application_steps: Contact the district horticulture office about active components.
Confirm the approved crop/component and application window.
Submit documents using the state-prescribed process.
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / State Horticulture Department
source: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture portal
note: The displayed crop tags are for recommendation relevance, not a complete notified crop list.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
description: Financing framework for eligible agriculture infrastructure projects under current fund guidelines.
benefits: Financing support for eligible infrastructure projects, subject to scheme and lender appraisal.
eligibility_criteria: Eligible project type, borrower, financing, and lender appraisal conditions apply.
Check the current official guidelines and participating lender requirements.
required_documents: Land/asset and lender documentation as applicable
application_steps: Review current eligible project categories.
Prepare a project proposal and supporting documents.
Submit through the official portal and participating financing institution.
note: A farmer-profile match does not establish borrower or project eligibility, credit approval, or loan terms.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
description: Fisheries and aquaculture development programme with activities and support subject to current state implementation.
benefits: Potential support for eligible fisheries or aquaculture activities under current state guidelines.
eligibility_criteria: Beneficiary, activity, technical, and cost-sharing conditions depend on the current component and state.
Confirm with the district fisheries department.
required_documents: Pond/lease or site records, if applicable
application_steps: Contact the district fisheries office about active components.
Confirm site, technical, and beneficiary requirements.
Apply through the current state-prescribed process.
note: The prototype only screens activity relevance; it does not assess pond, technical, or local beneficiary requirements.

name: National Livestock Mission
description: Livestock-sector programme with entrepreneurship and related components governed by current official guidelines.
benefits: Potential support for eligible livestock-sector activities under current guidelines and approvals.
eligibility_criteria: Eligible enterprise, activity, applicant, and financing requirements vary by programme component.
Check current guidelines and the state animal-husbandry department.
required_documents: Site/land and technical records as required
application_steps: Review current NLM components and eligibility.
Consult the state animal-husbandry department.
Submit a component-specific proposal through the current official process.
note: The prototype does not determine enterprise, loan, subsidy, or project eligibility.
